sections.Profile:
The Rolling Stones pinball machine by Stern, released in 2011, features music from the iconic band and combines classic pinball elements with a modern twist. Designed by Tom Kopera with software by Lonnie D. Ropp and Lyman F. Sheats Jr., it includes two flippers, two ramps, and a four-ball multiball mode.

- Manufacturer: Stern Pinball Inc.
- Years made: 2011
